movie.overview: Ichika is a high school musician who can enter a mysterious place called “SEKAI,” where she and her friends express their innermost emotions through music alongside Hatsune Miku. One day after giving a live performance, Ichika meets a new Miku that she has never seen before. No matter how hard this new Miku tries to sing, she struggles connecting with the hearts of her listeners. Miku must rely on the help of others to find a way to sing again.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: High school musician Ichika and her friends team up to help a newly discovered, silent Hatsune Miku recover her voice and learn how to reach people's hearts through music.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Ichika is a high school student and musician who frequently visits 'SEKAI,' a mysterious realm where emotions are expressed through music alongside Virtual Singers. After a live performance, Ichika encounters a unique, unfamiliar version of Hatsune Miku who finds herself completely unable to sing. Despite this Miku's desperate efforts to perform, her voice fails to connect with or touch the feelings of any listeners. Together with her friends, Ichika embarks on a heart-wrenching journey to help this troubled Miku rediscover the true meaning of song.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a world where music bridges the gap between inner feelings and reality, high school musician Ichika and her bandmates regularly visit the mysterious digital dimension known as 'SEKAI.' Within this realm, music serves as the ultimate medium for human emotion, guided by familiar Virtual Singers led by Hatsune Miku. Following an energetic live concert, Ichika stumbles upon a previously unseen version of Miku who appears lost and deeply distressed. This new Miku desperately attempts to perform, yet her voice remains completely silent and incapable of conveying emotion to those who listen. Determined not to let her suffer alone, Ichika and her friends rally together to investigate the root of Miku's inner turmoil. Through shared experiences, heartfelt conversations, and collaborative musical efforts, the group tries to understand the missing emotional spark blocking her song. Along the way, both the human musicians and the Virtual Singers reflect on their own deep connections to music and memory. Ultimately, through collective empathy and support, they guide the mysterious Miku toward unlocking her genuine feelings, restoring her voice so she can finally sing from the heart once again.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set in the vibrant universe of the popular music franchise, 'COLORFUL STAGE! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing' follows high school musician Ichika Hoshino, who possesses the unique ability to travel to 'SEKAI'—an alternate world born from true feelings where people express their emotions alongside Virtual Singers like Hatsune Miku. The story begins after a successful live show when Ichika encounters a mysterious, never-before-seen Miku who faces an existential crisis: no matter how hard she tries, she cannot produce a voice that reaches the hearts of listeners. As Ichika and her musical companions reach out to assist this silent Miku, they embark on an emotional journey exploring the deep connection between authentic feelings and the power of song.

story_structure.climax: Facing the emotional barriers that prevent the new Miku from reaching her listeners, the group puts everything into a pivotal musical effort to unlock her true expression.
story_structure.conflict: Following a live show, Ichika encounters a new and unfamiliar version of Miku who is unable to sing or connect with the hearts of listeners.
story_structure.resolution: Through collaboration and genuine emotion, Miku learns what it takes to convey her feelings through music, restoring harmony and hope within the SEKAI.
story_structure.introduction: Ichika and her friends express their true feelings through music in the mysterious domain of SEKAI alongside Hatsune Miku, balancing high school life with live performances.
story_structure.risingAction: Ichika and her friends step in to support the new Miku, embarking on a journey through music and emotional connection to help her rediscover her voice.

faq.answer: Yes, it is part of the Project SEKAI / Hatsune Miku franchise and serves as the first feature film adaptation of the mobile rhythm game HATSUNE MIKU: COLORFUL STAGE!.
faq.question: Is COLORFUL STAGE! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing part of a franchise?

faq.answer: The film primarily belongs to the animated musical and drama genres, incorporating elements of modern anime and Vocaloid pop music culture.
faq.question: What is the dominant genre of the film?

faq.answer: While playing the mobile game offers helpful context about the characters and the concept of SEKAI, the film presents an original storyline focused on helping a new version of Miku, making it approachable for general fans of anime and Hatsune Miku.
faq.question: Do I need to play the mobile game to understand the movie?

faq.answer: Yes, there is an extra scene after the credits (along with special end-credits musical content), which provides a tease regarding the new Miku and her SEKAI.
faq.question: Is there a post-credit scene in the movie?

faq.answer: The main protagonist is Ichika Hoshino, a high school musician who works alongside her friends and other SEKAI groups to help the new Miku regain her ability to sing.
faq.question: Who is the main protagonist of the movie?

faq.answer: The core conflict revolves around a new, mysterious Hatsune Miku who struggles to convey her voice and reach the hearts of listeners, prompting Ichika and her fellow musicians to help her find a way to sing again.
faq.question: What is the primary conflict in the film's plot?

faq.answer: The film was produced by the renowned Japanese animation studio P.A. Works.
faq.question: Which animation studio produced the film?

faq.answer: Yes, other popular Virtual Singers from the franchise—such as Kagamine Rin, Kagamine Len, Megurine Luka, MEIKO, and KAITO—appear alongside Miku.
faq.question: Are other Vocaloid characters included besides Hatsune Miku?

faq.answer: Yes, the film features original vocaloid tracks and musical arrangements written specifically for the storyline, expanding on the extensive music library of the franchise.
faq.question: Does the movie feature original songs?

faq.answer: Yes, it is a family-friendly anime film focused on emotional expression, friendship, and music, suitable for general audiences and fans of all ages.
faq.question: Is the movie suitable for all ages?
